raw_text: A ProPublica investigation reveals a coordinated Chinese state media campaign to blame India for COVID-19 origins using fabricated scientific evidence. The operation, linked to the Spamouflage network previously identified by Meta, leveraged at least 340 social media accounts across multiple platforms. Experts at Stanford Internet Observatory confirmed the preprint studies cited by CGTN and Global Times were methodologically flawed and selectively misquoted legitimate wastewater surveillance data.
clean_text: ProPublica investigation confirmed a coordinated Chinese state media campaign blaming India for COVID-19 origins, linked to the Spamouflage network, using fabricated scientific evidence and flawed preprint studies.
